messages:
maya: FYI onboarding LyraX-8B (Mistral family) to int4. Seeing deterministic loop in long summarize jobs (~2k tokens).

eli: drop the exact cmd + seed pls so infra can repro.

maya: `python run_gen.py --model lyrax-8b --quant int4 --max-tokens 2500 --seed 1234 --task summarization`. Loop begins ~tok 2127 repeating a 3-word phrase. fp16 clean.

frank: any conversion warnings? rotary/proj_order/kvcache offsets?

maya: convert.log had: WARN rotary_scale 1.0->0.92 for head-group 6; kvcache shows head_offset +1 on shard-2.

dora: smells like headmap/proj-order mismatch or tokenizer id drift (ZWJ/composed accents). Can you run token-diff?

maya: token-diff -> 18 mismatches, mostly ZWJ and accented chars. Also tried a runtime head-swap (swap 3 and 6): reduces loop but ROUGE drops ~0.6.

ops-bot: queued eval #9001 comparing fp16 / int4-raw / int4+swap / int4+tokfix. ETA ~12m.

eli: short-term mitigation = fallback to int8 for long requests. Add `--quant-fallback-threshold 1500` flag and enable behind feature-flag for lyrax-int4.

dora: long-term = fix convert headmap + add NFKC normalizer in tokenizer pipeline and add sliding-window perplexity to onboarding harness.

maya: opened PRs: convert#210, tokenizer#211, runtime-flag#212. Will enable staging flag and run 48-72h smoke. repro curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d @repro_lyrax_longctx.json`.

ops-bot: eval 9001 complete: fp16 ROUGE-L=41.9; int4(raw)=38.2; int4+swap=40.0; int4+tokfix=41.5; int4+fallback=41.6.

frank: fallback best QA for now. Track p99 latency and cost when it fires.

eli: agreed. Add regression `tests/onboard/lyrax_longctx_repro.txt` and CI check to validate headmap roundtrip.

maya: will follow up with monitoring dash links and alerting thresholds.
